Additional details

Make baby nail care easier and more comfortable with Momcozy’s Electric Baby Nail File. Dual soft lights provide 360° illumination to help you see clearly and avoid over-filing, while the quiet 35dB operation lets you gently trim little nails without disturbing your baby. With four speed settings, four age-appropriate grinding pads, and a rechargeable design, it’s a practical essential for everyday baby care. Features: Dual soft lights for 360° nail illumination Quiet operation as low as 35dB 4 adjustable speed settings Rechargeable design Includes 4 grinding pads for different ages
